title: Alert rule schema changes must mirror between alert_rule and alert_rule_version
answers: Do schema changes to alert_rule also need to be applied to alert_rule_version?
Why must alert_rule_version columns match alert_rule columns in Grafana Alerting?
What tables must be updated when modifying an alert rule column definition?
body:
Invariant: Schema modifications to alert_rule columns must be mirrored identically in alert_rule_version.
Enforced at: pkg/services/ngalert/store/alert_rule_test.go:TestIntegrationUpdateAlertRules
What breaks if skipped: Updating an alert rule writes a snapshot to alert_rule_version; if schemas diverge, rule updates fail on database insertion or truncate history data.
applies: Grafana Alerting rule storage and versioning schema migrations
